title: The Sister Fabian-Woody Herman Scholarship Fund in Milwaukee
summary: Herman describes the high school jazz scholarship fund named for his science teacher at St. John's Cathedral, which gives two $2,000 scholarships.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. You have an event that you treasure quite a bit, a great deal, really, each year, back in Minneapolis, don't you?
Milwaukee, I mean. Do you want to talk about that?

It's just a high school scholarship fund, that's what it is, for jazz students, and jazz soloists who come out of the stage bands. We opened it up last year or the year before to most of the state of Wisconsin -- it started in instead of just the southern part of the state and Milwaukee. And it's nonsectarian so it's open to all high schools and we have a very good board of judges and music people who listen to and audition all these people and they sit (unintelligible) one another and once a year we show up and do a benefit concert and give away two scholarships to help the person who wins them in their jazz education. And it is a complete jazz scholarship. And we've given away in the last couple of years, two $2,000 scholarships.
This is in the memory of one of your former teachers?

Yes, a nun who was one of my teachers in high school. She was a science teacher and so certainly had nothing to do with my endeavors. But she was a very human kind of person who believed that what I wanted so desperately -- and making the way for my plans for the future as a young man, and she coped with me and put up with me, and was very helpful to me.

And so I have always thought of her as a great friend, and a very helpful human being, who understood my plight. And consequently I put the scholarship fund in her name, along with mine. It's the Sister Fabian-Woody Herman Scholarship Fund.
And I'm very proud of this, and have now had it -- I think this is the 50th year coming up, and we hope after this season that it will be self --
Yes. But we've had great cooperation and great help.
St. John's Cathedral. Located in Milwaukee?
